content: OpenAI Realtime API is speech-to-speech (no STT/LLM/TTS hops), targets sub-500ms response, sub-800ms needed for natural turn-taking. Browser connects via WebRTC using an ephemeral client secret minted server-side at POST /v1/realtime/client_secrets with the real API key; browser POSTs SDP to /v1/realtime/calls with that ephemeral token. Current model id in docs example: gpt-realtime-2.1. Set OpenAI-Safety-Identifier server-side; it binds to the token.
